findings.title: [P1] Keep filenames out of the shell in lineCount
findings.body: A filename containing spaces is split into multiple arguments, and shell metacharacters in a caller-controlled filename can cause unintended commands to run with the Node process's privileges. Pass the filename as data rather than interpolating it into a shell command; for example, open the file with Node and count newline bytes directly.

findings.title: [P1] Restore iteration over every value in sum
findings.body: The loop stops before the final element, so `sum([5])` returns `0` instead of `5`. It also silently returns `0` for iterables without a `length`, such as a nonempty `Set`, which the previous implementation supported. Restoring `for...of` fixes both regressions.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve actionable configuration errors
findings.body: Malformed JSON and permission failures now return `{}`, making a broken configuration indistinguishable from a valid empty one and bypassing callers' existing error handling. Preserve the original exceptions; if a missing file is meant to be optional, limit the fallback to `ENOENT`.

findings.title: [P2] Store cache keys as own data properties
findings.body: On an ordinary object, assigning an object value under the key `__proto__` changes the store's prototype instead of creating a cache entry. Subsequent lookups can then return inherited values that were never cached. Define an own data property for each key so the fix also covers caller-supplied stores.

review_output.overall_explanation: The patch produces incorrect sums and hides configuration failures. The new helpers also interpret filenames as shell syntax and mishandle a valid cache key.
